references.text: The same procedure of isolation for seven days applies when the priest examines a skin lesion that is unclear or doubtful.
A parallel situation where the priest sees that there is no white hair in the spot, it is not deeper than the skin, and it is pale – the same criteria and the same isolation procedure apply.
A similar examination of scaly lesions where the priest isolates the person for seven days when the symptoms are unclear.
The priest also isolates objects with possible leprosy for seven days, the same time period as for people.
The priest shuts up a house for seven days in case of suspected leprosy – the same isolation principle applied to buildings.
Miriam was shut out from the camp for seven days because of leprosy, in accordance with the laws of Leviticus.
